**Continuous 2.8.1**, a community-maintained fork of the Continue VS Code extension. Continuous is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Continue Dev, Inc.

It installs alongside the original extension (its ID is `b1tninja.continuous`), brings your existing `~/.continue` configuration with it, and collects no telemetry. To update from 2.4.x, install the new `.vsix` the same way, or let the Marketplace update it. Coming from 2.4.1 or earlier, also see [Continued is now Continuous](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/tag/v2.4.2-vscode) in the 2.4.2 notes: the extension ID changed.

## Install

1. Download the `.vsix` for your platform below and, optionally, check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
2. Run `code --install-extension continuous-<platform>-2.8.1.vsix --force`, or in VS Code use the Extensions view: `...` → **Install from VSIX…**, then reload the window.

Requires VS Code 1.105 or newer. The packages are not code-signed. Full instructions: [install guide](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/blob/main/docs/continuous-install.md). Continuous is also on the VS Code Marketplace as **Continuous** (`b1tninja.continuous`).

| Platform                    | File                                                                     |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Windows x64 / Arm64         | `continuous-win32-x64-2.8.1.vsix`, `continuous-win32-arm64-2.8.1.vsix`   |
| macOS Apple Silicon / Intel | `continuous-darwin-arm64-2.8.1.vsix`, `continuous-darwin-x64-2.8.1.vsix` |
| Linux x64 / Arm64           | `continuous-linux-x64-2.8.1.vsix`, `continuous-linux-arm64-2.8.1.vsix`   |

Each platform also has an **agents** build, `continuous-<platform>-2.8.1-agents.vsix`. It adds Continuous to VS Code's Agents window through APIs that are still proposed, so it works in VS Code Insiders, or in Stable started with `code --enable-proposed-api b1tninja.continuous`. Without that it works like the normal build. See [VS Code Chat and Agents](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/customize/vscode-chat-and-agents).

## The CLI

The terminal agent is attached as `continuous-cli-2.8.1.tgz`. Install it on Node 22 or newer:

```sh
npm i -g https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/download/v2.8.1-vscode/continuous-cli-2.8.1.tgz
```

The package is `@b1tninja/continuous-cli` and the command is `continuous` (`continuous serve` is the headless server; the notes below call it `cn serve` where the docs do). It reads the same `~/.continuous` configuration as the extension.

## What's new since 2.8.0

**Commands in WSL**

- **Run the agent's terminal commands in WSL.** On Windows, set `continuous.terminal.shell` to `wsl` (and `continuous.terminal.wslDistro` to a name from `wsl -l`, or leave it empty for the default distribution) and each command runs in bash inside that distribution, starting in the workspace folder. The terminal agent reads `CONTINUOUS_TERMINAL_SHELL` (`wsl` or `wsl:<distro>`). The agent is told it is writing bash, and the command checks, rules and `effect:` classification read the command as bash. The command reaches bash exactly as written: `wsl.exe` was found to drop the quotes from `<<'EOF'` when given a command as an argument, so the command is sent encoded and decoded inside the distribution. This is where commands run, not isolation: a distribution can reach your Windows drives. See [Commands in WSL](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/ide-extensions/agent/terminal-in-wsl). (#405)

**Loop mode**

- **Parallel waves in the terminal agent.** `cn` and `cn serve` (with `loopParallel: true` in `POST /message`) run up to three to-dos with disjoint `files:` lines at the same time, each in its own git worktree with a fresh context, and merge their changes back one at a time as they finish. A change that does not merge sends its item back to run inline on the merged tree. The IDE's workers shipped in 2.6. These have run against scripted workers; no real model has run them yet. (#378)

## Not included

The JetBrains plugin and the hosted Continue Hub are not part of Continuous. Hub `uses: owner/name` blocks are not supported; configure models and blocks directly or with local file paths.
